text: Jim Beam, the Cadillac F1 partner, is a brand of Suntory Global Spirits, the spirits arm of Japan's privately held Suntory Holdings, which acquired Beam Inc. in 2014 (deal reported at the time at about $16bn; the 2014 acquisition itself, but not the $16bn figure, is confirmed by Suntory's own rebrand announcement).

source.name: Suntory Global Spirits - Beam Suntory rebrands to Suntory Global Spirits
source.quote: Since the acquisition of Beam Inc. in 2014, the company has gone through an incredible transformation
